subcategory_text: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders
note: No documented risk appetite statement approved by leadership

subcategory_text: The risks posed by a supplier are identified, recorded, and prioritized
note: Third-party inventory incomplete; no tiering of critical vendors

subcategory_text: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context
note: Security policy exists but not reviewed in over 24 months

subcategory_text: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained
note: Asset inventory in spreadsheets; ~20% coverage gap on endpoints

subcategory_text: Systems, hardware, software, and services are managed throughout their life cycles
note: Cloud resources not centrally tracked; misconfig drift undetected

subcategory_text: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded
note: Ad-hoc scanning only; no continuous vulnerability management

subcategory_text: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk
note: Risk scoring inconsistent across teams

subcategory_text: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated
note: MFA missing on several remote access paths

subcategory_text: Access permissions and authorizations are managed, incorporating least privilege
note: No privileged access management; standing admin rights common

subcategory_text: Personnel are provided cybersecurity awareness and training
note: Annual training only; no phishing simulation program

subcategory_text: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected
note: Full-disk encryption not enforced on all mobile devices

subcategory_text: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
note: Patch SLAs not defined; internet-facing appliances lag on updates

subcategory_text: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access
note: Flat network; limited segmentation of crown-jewel systems

subcategory_text: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
note: No 24x7 monitoring; alerts triaged next business day

subcategory_text: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find adverse events
note: No DLP or user-behavior analytics in enforcement mode

subcategory_text: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities
note: Limited correlation across log sources

subcategory_text: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties
note: IR plan exists but has never been tested via tabletop

subcategory_text: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
note: No defined breach-notification workflow or timelines

subcategory_text: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed
note: Backups not immutable; restore procedures untested

subcategory_text: Recovery activities and progress are communicated to stakeholders
note: Recovery comms ad-hoc; no template or cadence
